title: Home advantage
claim: In 2024-25 NBA regular-season games not played at a neutral site, the designated home team wins more than half of the games.
estimand: mean over eligible games of (home_win - 0.5); home_win includes overtime
sample: every sealed 2024-25 regular-season game with neutral_site == false (builder exclusions, quarantined games (D19) and listed neutral sites removed); one row per game
test: moving-block bootstrap over calendar days (kernels.moving_block_bootstrap): block 7 days, B=10000, seed 20261108; one-sided p = (1 + #{centred boot >= mean}) / (B + 1)
null: mean(home_win) - 0.5 <= 0 (home teams win at most half of eligible games)
decision_rule: SURVIVED_PROTOCOL iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND CI95 lower > 0 AND mean >= 0.01; NOT_SUPPORTED iff CI95 upper < 0.01; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE otherwise, or if fewer than 1000 eligible games or fewer than 5 non-overlapping 7-day blocks
